name: Grand Teton + Jackson Hole Bookable Loop

dates.why: Aug 31-Sep 13 gives two full weekends in the Tetons and keeps the easy ATL-JAC nonstop structure with a low-backtracking Jackson → park lodges → Teton Village route.

exchangeRateNote: Foreign-currency items use planning conversions and must be re-priced before booking.
positioning: Budget-friendly Teton loop by default, using Jackson/park practical lodging and keeping Jenny Lake Lodge as the big optional upgrade.
routeLabel: Jackson → Jenny Lake → Jackson Lake → Teton Village
routeRationale: The route is ordered as Jackson → Jenny Lake → Jackson Lake → Teton Village to reduce backtracking and keep the biggest transfers between lodging bases.
Each base lasts 2-4 nights so the baby has repeated sleep environments instead of daily hotel churn.
High-impact sights are paired with nearby backup options so weather does not break the trip.
The Ryan Shirley/video inspiration is used for idea generation, then validated with official tourism, park, hotel, airline, and activity sources.

budget.note: Reworked well under target by using practical park cabins/condos as the baseline. Jenny Lake Lodge remains the main upgrade lever.

recommended.label: Recommended Delta nonstop ATL-JAC
recommended.infantNote: Domestic infant-in-lap should not require a separate fare, but add infant to the reservation.
recommended.budgetNote: Planning snapshot uses ATL-JAC Delta nonstop references and current Expedia fare-from signal; re-price Aug 31-Sep 13 before booking.

alternates.label: Cash/points alternative
alternates.summary: Re-price on Delta with flexible dates and compare points value before booking.
